question: By what means does Kṛṣṇa stir the minds of the cowherd women?
premises: Kṛṣṇa agitates the minds of the cowherd women.
He uses glances to do so.
His glances are smiling and sidelong.
inference: Kṛṣṇa stirs the cowherd women's minds with his smiling sidelong glances.
plain_english: Agitating their minds with his smiling sidelong glances.
